historical_references.reference: Rashu was a king of the Vatsa dynasty, ruling from approximately 550 BC to 520 BC. He is best known for his conquest of the kingdom of Kosala, which brought him into conflict with the famous Buddhist sage Valmiki.

Another Rashu is mentioned in the Mahabharata epic, as a king of Pragjyotisha (Assam) who ruled during the Mahabharata war period (around 3067 BC). He is known for his friendship with Bhishma Pitamaha, the grandsire of the Pandavas.
